CBSE Board 12th Result 2026 - Complete Details

CBSE Board 12th Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
